Vendored snapshot of https://github.com/google/ukey2 (master, ~2026-01-20 per archive mtimes; exact commit not recorded), Apache 2.0 (see LICENSE). Java and ukey2_shell.cc omitted.
Include roots needed: `-I third_party/ukey2`, `-I third_party/ukey2/src/main/cpp/include`, and `-I <protoc output dir>` for generated `*.pb.h`. See BUILD_NOTES.md.
